settings.title: Settings
settings.steamHint: The key is stored encrypted (Windows DPAPI) in the data folder. On the key page you can enter localhost as the domain. For status via Web API, game details must be public in your Steam privacy settings.
settings.statusHint: Status updates on its own: when Steam saves the game's stats and on a timer while the game is running. Without a Web API key, status is read from the Steam client.

settings.manualHint: While this is off, progress counts only achievements unlocked in the game.
settings.writeHint: The "To Steam" button writes an achievement right away in any mode; the unlock time becomes the time of writing. Protected achievements (granted only by the game server) cannot be written. Every write is logged to unlock_log.jsonl.
settings.hideSpoilers: Hide descriptions of hidden achievements until unlocked
settings.spoilersHint: A hidden description is blurred - click it to read. The overlay always shows them.
settings.overlayHint: Shortcuts like Ctrl+Shift+A. The overlay shows over windowed and borderless games, not over exclusive fullscreen.
settings.dataPortable: Portable mode: data is kept in the data folder next to the app.

settings.checkUpdates: Check for a new version at startup
settings.updatesHint: Looks at the latest release on GitHub. Download opens the new version's zip in the browser: unpack it over the app folder.

dialog.manualUnlocks:
This adds a "Done" checkbox for achievements Steam did not count and lets the app write achievements to your Steam account.

Valve does not officially support such writes, and ranking sites (Steam Hunters, completionist.me) may flag a profile when many achievements unlock at once. Written achievements can be revoked, and every write is logged.

Turn it on?
